www-7633928.description: ...KoGaMa Legends... Each the character has own skills and weapons. To check it, you must go back to the menu (Click [ESC]) and then Click "Class" And press the "i" icon. To fight you have to choose your character, choose the world and weapons. For each kill you get crystals thanks to which you can Unlock new characters. To win round you must collect 20 kills. We wish have a nice game. Special Thanks to: _ KaMyK _ _ Grumpy _ KeKerr quba28 ._-Captain_Martakal-_. Words from ._Kacperiozzo_.: Best builders I've ever had :') Thank you so much! #ROAD_TO_1MILLION_PLAYS #GAME_OF_THE_WEEK Project was created 21.09.2019 [Polish] Witaj w Grze "KoGaMa LEGENDS" W tej grze chodzi o to byś wybrał swoją postać i zawalczył różnych niesamowitych krainach. Każda postać ma swoje umiejętności i broń. By to sprawdzić musisz wrócić do menu (Kliknąć [ESC]) a następnie Kliknąć "Class" I nacisnąć na ikonkę litery "i". By stoczyć walkę musisz wybrać swoją postać, wybrać świat i broń. Za każdego killa dostajesz kryształy dzięki ktorym możesz odblokowywać nowe postacie. By wygrać rundę musisz zebrać 20 killi. Życzymy miłej rozgrywki.
